<!-- ======================= THE PROBLEM ======================= -->
<section class="section">
<div class="container">
<div class="grid align-items-center gap-5">
<div class="g-col-12 g-col-lg-6">
<span class="eyebrow">The Problem</span>
<h2>Fieldwork is slow, costly, and often out of reach.</h2>
<p class="text-muted fs-5">
Many undergraduate and postgraduate research projects stall at the data
collection stage. Household surveys and enumeration take weeks, travel and
logistics strain student budgets, and small self-collected samples limit
how far a dissertation's analysis can go.
</p>
<p class="text-muted fs-5">
Meanwhile, high-quality socio-economic survey data already exists —
collected by national statistics agencies, research institutes, and
development partners — but it is scattered, hard to discover, and rarely
packaged for classroom or thesis use.
</p>
</div>
<div class="g-col-12 g-col-lg-6">
<div class="grid gap-3">
<div class="g-col-6">
<div class="step-card text-center">
<i class="bi bi-hourglass-split step-icon"></i>
<div class="fw-semibold">Weeks lost</div>
<div class="text-muted small">to travel &amp; enumeration</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="g-col-6">
<div class="step-card text-center">
<i class="bi bi-cash-coin step-icon"></i>
<div class="fw-semibold">High cost</div>
<div class="text-muted small">of independent fieldwork</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="g-col-6">
<div class="step-card text-center">
<i class="bi bi-graph-down step-icon"></i>
<div class="fw-semibold">Small samples</div>
<div class="text-muted small">limit statistical power</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="g-col-6">
<div class="step-card text-center">
<i class="bi bi-signpost-split step-icon"></i>
<div class="fw-semibold">Hard to discover</div>
<div class="text-muted small">existing quality datasets</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>

<!-- ======================= HOW IT WORKS ======================= -->
<section class="section section-alt">
<div class="container">
<div class="text-center mb-5">
<span class="eyebrow">How It Works</span>
<h2>From browsing to your dataset, in four steps</h2>
<p class="text-muted fs-5 mx-auto" style="max-width:40rem;">
A simple, transparent workflow designed around how student research actually happens.
</p>
</div>
<div class="grid gap-4">
<div class="g-col-12 g-col-md-6 g-col-lg-3">
<div class="step-card">
<div class="step-number">1</div>
<h5><i class="bi bi-search me-1 text-accent"></i> Browse</h5>
<p class="text-muted mb-0">Search and filter the catalog by topic, region, and year to find the dataset your research needs.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="g-col-12 g-col-md-6 g-col-lg-3">
<div class="step-card">
<div class="step-number">2</div>
<h5><i class="bi bi-send-fill me-1 text-accent"></i> Request</h5>
<p class="text-muted mb-0">Submit a short access request describing your research purpose and supervisor details.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="g-col-12 g-col-md-6 g-col-lg-3">
<div class="step-card">
<div class="step-number">3</div>
<h5><i class="bi bi-check-circle-fill me-1 text-accent"></i> Get Approved</h5>
<p class="text-muted mb-0">An administrator reviews the request and approves access under the dataset's usage terms.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="g-col-12 g-col-md-6 g-col-lg-3">
<div class="step-card">
<div class="step-number">4</div>
<h5><i class="bi bi-download me-1 text-accent"></i> Download</h5>
<p class="text-muted mb-0">Download the dataset and citation details, ready to bring into your analysis.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p class="text-center text-muted small mt-4">
<i class="bi bi-info-circle me-1"></i>
In this proof of concept, steps 3–4 are demonstrated as mock states — see the
<a href="guidelines.html">Guidelines &amp; FAQ</a> page for what's real vs. simulated.
</p>
</div>
</section>
